text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Frederick Chiluba arrives in Gabarone, Botswana, for a heads of state Commonwealth Africa meeeting.
- Finance minister Ronald Penza says he will appeal against a court ruling in which he was found guilty of contempt of court.
- The state-run Zambia Education Publishing House is placed under receivership.
- The state has intensified its surveillance of opposition leaders, the United National Independence Party claims.
